turns.text: HIP is something a system does, not something a system is. Any system acts as a HIP the moment it publishes a record: it links care contexts to a patient's ABHA address, answers discovery requests, and hands over encrypted FHIR bundles once a consented request arrives. Publishing is M2 work.
No, I meant the HIU side, what does that role do?

must_contain: HIU is the role a system plays when it asks to read someone else's health records
it requests consent, waits for the patient to grant it, then fetches against the artefact
it never gets data without a granted consent artefact, and the patient can revoke at any time
notes: user corrects the assistant to the other role; the second answer is hiu.md's own plain-words text, not a rehash of the HIP answer.
